summary: Gothic entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Gothic
entries.definitive_edition: Gothic 1 Remake for modern play; original PC/Gothic Classic for historical fidelity

emulation.notes: Use native remake or original PC compatibility route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Gothic 1 Remake for modern visuals; original PC for exact history

primary.version: Gothic 1 Remake for modern play; Gothic Classic/original for exact-history comparison
primary.why: Gothic's current high-fidelity route is the 2026 Gothic 1 Remake, but the 2001 Piranha Bytes original remains historically distinct. Use the remake for a normal modern archive run and keep Gothic Classic/original PC as the preservation route for exact controls, quest behavior, and period jank.
primary.how_to_play: Use Gothic 1 Remake for the main modern route if available, recording patch, platform, difficulty, localization, and quest changes. If preserving the original, use Gothic Classic or the original PC release with compatibility fixes and log the route separately.

secondary.exclusive_content: Exact 2001 design, controls, bugs, and progression behavior
secondary.what_to_play: Use if the archive goal is historical fidelity rather than modern play.
secondary.why: The remake is a reimagining, not a perfect replacement for the original.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether the run uses remake or original, because mechanics, controls, localization, and quest behavior can differ.

entries.title: Gothic 3
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with Community Patch/fix state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC build with exact official/community patch state documented

primary.version: Current PC release with Community Patch state documented
primary.why: The PC release is the core route, but Gothic 3's archive quality depends heavily on patch state. Community Patch 1.75 and other fixes are widely documented, so the capture must label vanilla versus patched behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam/GOG PC release with the intended official/community patch state. Record storefront/build, Community Patch version, Alternative Balancing/AI choices, resolution/fixes, difficulty, faction route, and whether Forsaken Gods was excluded.

secondary.what_to_play: Document as its own route if needed.
secondary.why: It is not part of the base Gothic 3 entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: Forsaken Gods is a separate standalone expansion route.
